name: Account Access Problems
description: The customer cannot get into their account.

name: Password Not Accepted
description: The customer’s password is not accepted during login.

name: Unclear Billing Complaint
description: The example is a generic, unclear complaint about charges.

name: Basic Controls Require Premium
description: Customers say choosing specific songs or skipping tracks requires a premium subscription.

name: Features Moved Behind Premium
description: The customer says everything has become premium.

name: Missing Songs and Genres
description: Customers report that songs or desired genres are missing from the catalog.

name: Lyrics Missing From Songs
description: Customers say lyrics are unavailable for some songs.

name: Recommendations Have Declined
description: The customer says music recommendations are worse than before.

name: Downloads Get Stuck
description: Song downloads can remain stuck in the background.

name: Offline Playback Fails
description: The customer says offline playback does not work.

name: Mixed Generic App Complaints
description: Mixed generic complaints express dissatisfaction with the app or a recent update without identifying a specific defect.

name: Unable to Connect on Wi-Fi
description: The customer cannot connect to the internet while using Wi-Fi.

name: App Crashes or Gets Stuck
description: The app crashes, remains stuck on its loading screen, or stops during playback.

name: Songs Do Not Play
description: The customer says songs do not play.

name: Playback Adjustment Malfunction
description: The customer says music adjustment does not work properly.

name: Frequent and Loud Ads
description: Customers complain that ads are too frequent or too loud.

name: Mixed Playback and Ad Complaints
description: Mixed complaints mention excessive ads or shuffled playback without identifying a more specific defect.

name: Playlist Plays Songs Randomly
description: The customer says playlist songs play in random order.

name: Missing Playback Controls and Settings
description: Customers report difficulty repeating, seeking, controlling automatic playback, or using the redesigned home screen.
